description: Real-time AI desktop assistant — interview copilot, screen analysis, automated notes.

cliInstall.npmLink: npm link   # from this checkout: exposes `smog-ai` and `npx smog-ai` on PATH, launches the packaged build in ./release

windows: https://github.com/Bolu-Tife-dev/smog-ai/releases/latest  # download page with the published NSIS installer
winget install --id ai.smog.desktop  # after publishing to winget
macos: https://github.com/Bolu-Tife-dev/smog-ai/releases/latest  # download the DMG (Intel or Apple Silicon)
buildFromSource: cd smog-ai && npm install && npm run package

installCommandNotes: npm run package builds installers for the host platform into ./release
Cross-platform targets: npm run package:win | package:mac | package:linux (macOS targets require macOS)

Published installers live on https://github.com/Bolu-Tife-dev/smog-ai/releases — push a v* tag and the Release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml) builds Windows EXE + macOS DMG and attaches them automatically
Replace <release-host> for the shell bootstrap once install.sh is hosted
setupRequirements: OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY — required; no key ships with the app (BYOK) and is read dynamically from ~/.config/smog-ai/config.json
LLM_MODEL_NAME — required; no model ships as a source default (e.g. mimov2.6), stored in ~/.config/smog-ai/config.json
Network access to the configured base URL (default https://opencode.zen/v1) for chat completions and transcriptions
Microphone permission for the Listen channel (Windows Settings › Privacy › Microphone)
System loopback permission for the remote-interviewer channel — Windows-only, enabled by the setDisplayMediaRequestHandler loopback source
Screen capture permission for Vision / screen scan / screen watch (desktopCapturer)
Electron safeStorage (OS keychain) for encrypting the stored key; plaintext JSON is used only when the keychain is unavailable
Optional: a dedicated STT model for /audio/transcriptions; the chat audio fallback is used when STT_MODEL_NAME is empty

configuration.summary: Smog AI never ships with a hardcoded key. Configure your own OpenCode Zen credentials on first launch.
steps: Launch the app — the first-run settings modal opens automatically (reopen anytime via the Params HUD button or the gear icon in the title bar)
Paste your OpenCode Zen API key into the API key field (starts with "zk-") — stored as OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY
Set the model field (e.g. mimov2.6) — stored as LLM_MODEL_NAME
Leave the base URL at https://opencode.zen/v1 (default) or point it at a compatible OpenAI-style endpoint
Optional — enable dual-channel (system loopback) capture, then expand "Advanced model parameters" for max_tokens, top_p, STT model and a raw JSON extraBody object
Click "Save configuration" — the key is encrypted with the OS keychain (Electron safeStorage) and written to ~/.config/smog-ai/config.json

Start the mic with the Listen HUD button, type a question into the quick-ask box (or hold Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+Space anywhere), then press Ask — or toggle Auto-Pilot (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+A) to answer detected questions automatically
Export generated notes to PDF or Markdown from the Notes tab; the app is stealth by default (hidden from screenshots and screen shares)

fields.sttModel: STT_MODEL_NAME — optional; falls back to chat audio transcription when empty
fields.extraBody: Free-form JSON merged into every chat completion body
fields.stealth: OS-level content protection — window is excluded from screenshots and screen sharing (default ON)
fields.alwaysOnTop: Keep the main window above other windows
fields.language: Optional BCP-47 language hint for transcription
fields.systemAudio: Dual-channel capture — record system loopback audio alongside the microphone
fields.autoPilot: Auto-Pilot mode — detected question utterances stream through the API automatically
fields.screenWatch: Interval screen watcher that keeps spatial context fresh

configuration.encryption: Config payload is encrypted with safeStorage when available; otherwise stored as plaintext JSON

globalShortcuts.pushToAsk: CommandOrControl+Alt+Space (hold to open the quick-ask prompt)

verification.e2e: 38/38 CHECKS PASSED — node scripts/e2e.mjs (CDP port 9333, local OpenAI mock)
verification.package: OK — npm run package (electron-builder NSIS, Windows x64)
verification.packagedSmokeTest: OK — release/win-unpacked/Smog AI.exe boots and serves the renderer from app.asar

features.stealth: Content protection on every BrowserWindow (setContentProtection + screen-saver level overlay flags) — ON by default so the app never appears in screenshots or screen shares; Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+H toggles the overlay
features.dualChannelAudio: Microphone (getUserMedia) + system loopback (getDisplayMedia, Windows) recorded in parallel and transcribed as separate channels
features.hud: Floating + docked control bar (Listen/Vision/Ask/Notes/Params), draggable with edge snapping, tabs, separate always-on-top HUD window
features.quickAsk: On-screen text input (main window + overlay) — typed questions are sent with the full live transcript to OpenCode Zen
features.pushToAsk: Hold Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+Space to open a focused quick-ask prompt anywhere; release keeps it open, Enter queries the AI
features.notesExport: Session minutes, action items and summaries generated via OpenCode Zen; exported to PDF (printToPDF) or Markdown files
features.autoPilot: Debounced question detection over the live transcript streams structured answers automatically (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+A)
features.screenWatch: Interval frame hashing keeps spatial context fresh; instant active-window scan via Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+V
features.activeWindowVision: Vision captures the foreground window bounding box (desktopCapturer window sources, Smog AI windows excluded) before sending it to the vision model
features.byok: No shipped key or model — OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY / LLM_MODEL_NAME read from ~/.config/smog-ai/config.json
